Turnkey · Bengaluru

Hoot Cafe & Brewery

An open-air café and brewery in Bengaluru, built around water, greenery and honest materials: a weekend escape in the middle of the city.

Location
Bengaluru
Venue
Café & brewery
Scope
Turnkey: design & execution
Spaces
Courtyard, bars & rooftop
The project

A place people stay in for the whole evening.

The plan opens into a large courtyard wrapped by upper levels, with indoor bars and a rooftop terrace, so every part of the visit feels like a different room.

The language is relaxed and tropical-industrial. Turquoise water channels run between the tables, palms and planters soften the hard edges, and the raw materials (timber, bamboo, grey blockwork and steel) are left honest. Playful set pieces, from a vintage wooden boat to a giant gramophone horn, give guests something new to discover on every visit.

Inside HOOT

Space by space

The courtyard

The heart of Hoot: decked seating islands between long turquoise water channels, shaded by palms. After dark, low warm lighting reflects off the water and the courtyard becomes the main event.

The central bar

A long open bar anchors the courtyard: a timber-slatted counter, bold red bar stools and bamboo screens behind it, visible from almost every seat.

Upper levels

The mezzanine looks down on the courtyard through geometric steel railings, while white line-art murals keep the large grey walls light and playful.

The indoor lounge

Inside, the mood turns intimate: a sculptural tree strung with lights against a dark green wall, a classic red phone box and stone-textured floors.

The speakeasy bar

A darker, moodier bar with a faceted metal feature wall, a reclaimed-timber counter and wire-frame pendant lights over industrial stools.

The rooftop

An open terrace above the neighbourhood with patterned cement tiles, bistro seating and warm lighting for long evenings.
